summary_en: Board resolution on 24 June 2026 to implement measures aligned with capital-cost and share-price conscious management. Specific metrics, targets, and timelines not disclosed in this cover page.
title_en: Notice Regarding Measures for Realizing Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Share Price
translation_en_brief: On 24 June 2026, Shionogi & Co., Ltd. held a board meeting and resolved to implement measures toward realizing management conscious of capital cost and share price. The cover page states that the company has analysed its current situation and determined future strategic directions, but detailed metrics, targets, and implementation timelines are not provided in this opening notice and are instead contained in the attached materials (not shown in the provided excerpt).
